entries.text: This is it. The park beneath the sea that has\ngained renown around the world...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_01

entries.text: Our very own [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terarium[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_02

entries.text: We may be underwater, but the projectors built\ninto the walls and ceiling make it feel like we’re\r\nactually outside, don’t they?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_03

entries.text: We’ve been able to create a comfortable\nenvironment for Pokémon through technology![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_04

entries.text: I designed all this myself! And believe me—it\nwasn’t cheap.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_01

entries.text: Within this dome, there are four distinct biomes.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_05

entries.text: Here we have the nice and toasty subtropical\nSavanna Biome.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_06

entries.text: Then, off to your right, you can see the breezy,\ntropical Coastal Biome.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_07

entries.text: Further out to your left, you’ll see the craggy,\ncrunchy, rugged Canyon Biome.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_08

entries.text: Last but not least, waaay out in the distance, we\nhave the arctic and snowy Polar Biome![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_09

entries.text: Each biome’s air temperature and humidity levels\nare regulated with the utmost care.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_10

entries.text: That’s why you can find completely different\nPokémon species living in each area![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_11

entries.text: We sure put a lot of effort into it![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Tell me, [VAR 0x0100(0000)], which biome
tickles
your
fancy
off
the bat?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_12

entries.text: The subtropical Savanna Biome
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_01

entries.text: The tropical Coastal Biome
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_02

entries.text: The craggy Canyon Biome
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_03

entries.text: The snowy Polar Biome
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_04

entries.text: It’s a very familiar sort of environment, isn’t it?\c\nThe open stretches of land make it very easy to\nobserve how the Pokémon are living.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_13

entries.text: Goodness, really? It seems you and I will get\nalong just great, then—that’s my favorite, too!\r\nThe breezy atmosphere is just so calming![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_14

entries.text:
Oh, so you like things that are a bit rough and
rugged, do you?\c
You can also find a mysterious ore in that biome
that we call “chargestone”![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_15

entries.text: Oh, so you like it cold, do you?\c\nI’m not very good with the cold myself, but Ice-\ntype Pokémon can be awfully cute![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_16

entries.text: If you need to heal up your team while you’re\ndown here, feel free to use the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]self-serve healing[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]\r\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]machines[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] we’ve installed around the Terarium.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_17

entries.text: Now then. Director Cyrano...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_18

entries.text: Can you explain to us why crystals form here, and\nhow the wild Pokémon are able to Terastallize?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_19

entries.text: I—huh? But don’t you know already, Lacey, that...\nOooh, I get it! You want me to do the talking.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_03

entries.text: In that case, let me show you—the reason is\nactually right above our heads![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_04

entries.text: That there is the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terarium Core[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], which presides\nover all that happens in the Terarium.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_05

entries.text: It contains a fluid that we’ve jam-packed full of\na special material from Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_06

entries.text: It’s constantly emitting Terastal energy—that’s\nwhat allows Pokémon to Terastallize in the dome![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_07

entries.text: Wonderful! Well said, sir! That’s exactly right![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_20

entries.text: Though...I still don’t know what that “special\nmaterial” is, within the Terarium Core itself.\r\nIt’s never been shared publicly, has it?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_21

entries.text: Ohoho, you want to know? Well, in fact, it’s...\c\nIt’s...[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_08

entries.text: Now what was it? I’ve plumb forgotten.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_09

entries.text: Briar put all of it together, so I’m not certain\nmyself.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_16

entries.text: That’s...what I thought you might say.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_22

entries.text: *bing-bong-bong-bing* ♪
entries.label: sdc02_0060_system_01

entries.text: Practical battle class will commence shortly in\nthe Coastal Biome.
entries.label: sdc02_0060__announcement_01

entries.text: Students participating in this class should make\ntheir way to the Coastal Biome now.
entries.label: sdc02_0060__announcement_02

entries.text: *bong-bing-bing-bong* ♪
entries.label: sdc02_0060_system_02

entries.text: Oh! It looks like you’re just in time to see a class\nsession too![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_23

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]This is too good of a chance to pass up. Won’t
you join us, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?
You
can
get
your
first
taste
of
our
school’s
classes.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_24

entries.text: Teehee! I do love to see that sort of passion for\neducation![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_25

entries.text: B-but it’s such a great opportunity to learn!\nYou can’t tell me you don’t like studying![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_26

entries.text: I’ll go ahead and register the Terarium map to\nyour Rotom Phone for you.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_27

entries.text: The [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terarium map [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]has been added to your\nmap app!
entries.label: sdc02_0060_system_03

entries.text: It’s fun to take a stroll through the Terarium on\nyour own, and I think I’d be more of a hassle\r\nthan anything if you had me holding your hand...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_28

entries.text: So, yup, that settles it! Please find your way to\nthe class site in the Coastal Biome on your own![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_29

entries.text: Well, doesn’t seem like I’m needed here.[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_10

entries.text: Wait, sir, you don’t—[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_30

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]But I’ve made sure that a dorm room has been
all set up for you,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
so
don’t
forget
to
give
it
a
visit
later![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_11

entries.text: Oh yes, and one other thing: Could you open\nyour Pokédex app for me?[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_13

entries.text: The [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Blueberry Pokédex[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] has been added to\nyour Pokédex app!
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_15

entries.text: Catch as many Pokémon here in the Terarium as\nyou please—don’t be afraid to go Sawsbuck-wild![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_14

entries.text: It’s your student life here at Blueberry Academy,\nso remember to live it up to the fullest![VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_12

entries.text: And there he goes...[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_31

entries.text: Well, you can at least count on me to be around\nwhen you need me, so there’s no call for concern![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_32

entries.text: It’s probably time we both head to class! I’ll be\nwaiting for you to join us in the Coastal Biome![VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_33
